items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I was a confidante of Glenn’s. Glenn and I were close.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, here in Sarasota, and it’s my great pleasure to have saxophonist and arranger Jerry Jerome. Welcome.
Thank you, Monk. It’s good to be here.
It’s great to be down here.
